info.description: Timatic AutoCheck is a solution that verifies traveller documentation and checks if it is sufficient for the whole journey. When documents related to passengers' destination/transit are not sufficient, Timatic provides details about the travel rules and required documents. This is technical documentation for anyone involved in interfacing with Timatic via REST API.
info.title: Timatic AutoCheck REST API (Staging)

post.summary: Resource to perform document check and obtain a decision
post.description: This is a decision service and it has to be used when determining whether traveler has sufficient documentation to travel to a specified country. Based on the request data from the client containing itenerary and document details, Document Check API service evaluates against travel rules and regulations that apply to the passenger and provides an outcome, stating whether passenger is allowed to travel or not (together with any relevant information). Responses for Document Check can be customized based on the User preferences set in the Timatic Manager application. This API will be multilingual, i.e. response will be returned in the language specified by the client.

200.description: Returns the values requested for the Document Check request

get.description: The Parameter Value request is used to determine the possible values for a particular request parameter(s). Clients can also use this service to find the values required in the string fields of the documentCheckRequest. In this case, it is the name element that is returned in the response, which is used as the value in the documentCheckRequest.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Parameter Code for which values have to be retrieved

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Parameter name for which values have to be retrieved

200.description: Returns the values requested for the paramName or paramCode

get.summary: Resource to retrieve Timatic News articles.
get.description: This API will be used to get Timatic News articles.

200.description: Returns the values requested for the paramName or paramCode

get.summary: Resource to retrieve Terms and Definitions
get.description: This API returns the Terms and Definitions based on term group code and terms code.

200.description: Returns the values requested for Terms & Definitions

get.summary: Find all locations by location type, code and name
get.description: This API service can be used to find location from location type, code and name. It will retun all locations and their corresponding list of dependent (child) locations.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Client should pass country codes as two-, three-, or five-letter values as a search criteria filter to apply to search results

parameters.name: locationType
parameters.description: The location type is used to filter the search result. If client passes only location type for search then in response sub-location field will not be included. The allowed location types are COUNTRY, CITY, AIRPORT, HELIPORT, SEAPORT, BUS TERMINAL, RAILWAY STATION, LOCATION GROUP.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The user can pass a name used to apply wildcard search filters on criteria of search result

200.description: Returns the values requested for Terms & Definitions

get.summary: Resource to retrieve parameter values per country/location
get.description: This API can be used to identify potential values of a parameter which may result in a favorable evaluation response for a given country and Rule Set type. For provided country and Rule Set type(s), all values for the given parameter which are used in the rule having YES or CONDITIONAL outcome will be returned in the API response.

parameters.name: ruleSetTypes
parameters.description: List of Rule Set type codes

200.description: Returns the values requested for Terms & Definitions

post.summary: Resource to perform country information and obtain a information
post.description: This is a country information service to get the information related to rules specified by the countries.

200.description: Returns the values requested for the country information request

post.summary: Resource to perform accepted values to fetch document
post.description: This API returns the document codes against each rule set type for the requested document category, regulation applicability, nationality and location whereas sending a list of rule set type is optioanl.

200.description: Returns the values of document Code for the accepted values request

post.summary: Resource to perform boarding status log
post.description: This is a boarding status service to log the information related to boarding status of a passenger logged against document request response.

200.description: Returns the values requested for the boarding status request
